name: 同窗请帖

roles.name: 霜糖
roles.voice: young female, sweet mid register, restrained and cool, steady pace, clear articulation

roles.name: 曜阳
roles.voice: young male, athletic chest-supported voice, stable mid pitch, brisk and even pace, clear articulation

look: 精致二维动画风格，明亮清爽的色彩，干净的线条与平涂阴影，现代都市日常短剧质感。
setting: 午后明亮的自然光从画面一侧斜照进来，混着柔和的暖色环境光，整体明亮温暖。
constraints: 全片一个生成片段，机位固定，两人始终保持左右位置与坐姿，全程都在画面内；一方说话时另一方的嘴唇保持闭合。全程中文对话，语气自然：角色2像在讲一件又好笑又无奈的事，越讲越起劲；角色1听得认真，有点替他着急。台词逐句说出，每句之间留短暂停顿；最后一句说完后角色1反应过来笑出声。画面中只有这两名角色。
source_script:
角色2：你们说好笑不好笑，有一个同学，从没给我打过电话，现在要结婚了，给我送来了请帖，要我随礼。
角色1动作：她微微皱起眉头，认真地看着他。
角色1：同学结婚邀请你，是想跟你联络一下感情，别光想着钱，你这位同学是大学的还是中学的？
角色2动作：他苦笑着摇了摇头。
角色2：是学车的，一共就学了三天车
角色1动作：她愣了一下，随即笑出声来。

events.text: 你们说好笑不好笑，有一个同学，从没给我打过电话，现在要结婚了，给我送来了请帖，要我随礼。
她微微皱起眉头，认真地看着他。
同学结婚邀请你，是想跟你联络一下感情，别光想着钱，你这位同学是大学的还是中学的？
是学车的，一共就学了三天车
她愣了一下，随即笑出声来。

execution.look: A refined two-dimensional animation style with a bright clean palette, clean linework and flat cel shading, in the look of a contemporary urban slice-of-life short film.
execution.setting: Bright afternoon daylight comes in from one side of the frame together with soft warm ambient light, keeping the whole image bright and warm.
execution.visible_state: Bright afternoon daylight comes in from one side together with soft warm ambient light, keeping the whole frame bright and warm. Character 1 sits on the left of frame facing right, her arms folded, her cheeks slightly puffed and her gaze turned away with a cool, guarded look. Character 2 sits on the right of frame facing left, one hand raised near his temple in a boyish salute, wearing a broad open grin.

directions.event_002: Character 1 furrows her brows slightly and studies Character 2 with a serious, questioning look.
directions.event_004: Character 2 shakes his head with a wry, helpless smile.
directions.event_006: Character 1 freezes for a beat, then breaks into laughter.
